description: React component for displaying and managing details of a document store, including loaders, actions, and related dialogs.

methods.name: openPreviewSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the document store's preview settings page.

methods.name: showStoredChunks
methods.description: Navigates to view and edit chunks of a specific loader.

methods.name: showVectorStoreQuery
methods.description: Navigates to the retrieval query page for a specific store.

methods.name: onDocLoaderSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a document loader from the list.

methods.name: showVectorStore
methods.description: Navigates to the vector store page.

methods.name: listLoaders
methods.description: Opens dialog to select a document loader.

methods.name: deleteVectorStoreDataFromStore
methods.description: Deletes vector store data for a specific document ID.

methods.name: onDocStoreDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of document store or loader with confirmation and snackbar notifications.

methods.name: onLoaderDelete
methods.description: Prepares and shows delete confirmation dialog for a loader.

methods.name: onStoreDelete
methods.description: Prepares and shows delete confirmation dialog for the store.

methods.name: onStoreRefresh
methods.description: Refreshes all loaders and chunks after user confirmation.

methods.name: onEditClicked
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit document store details.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Refetches specific document store data after editing.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Opens actions menu for document store.

methods.name: onViewUpsertAPI
methods.description: Opens API view/upsert dialog for a loader.
